stages.headline: A ball is obtained by rotating a half-disc about its diameter; all points of its surface (the sphere) are R from the centre.
stages.headlineEnglish: A ball is obtained by rotating a half-disc about its diameter; all points of its surface (the sphere) are R from the centre.

stages.headline: Every plane section of a ball is a disc; the section through the centre is a great circle with radius R.
stages.headlineEnglish: Every plane section of a ball is a disc; the section through the centre is a great circle with radius R.

stages.headline: If the plane is at distance d from the centre, the section's radius is r = √(R² − d²).
stages.headlineEnglish: If the plane is at distance d from the centre, the section's radius is r = √(R² − d²).
